R0064.title: Order-Splitting Arbitrage
R0064.definition: Exploiting shipping thresholds, price differences, or bundled gift items by placing abnormal combined orders and then canceling part of the order to extract benefits.
R0064.description: Many trading platforms offer free shipping above a certain amount, tiered discounts, gifts, or rebates. Attackers first build up an order to meet the benefit threshold, then return some or all of the items to extract the benefit.
R0064.influence: Extracts platform or merchant discounts and rebates.

references.title: CCTV: Will Instant Refunds After Order Padding Have Consequences?

observables: An order is padded to meet a discount, free-shipping, or gift threshold and then part of the items are immediately returned
Low-unit-price or gift-link items are used for padding, with partial refunds applied to the whole order afterward
The same account repeatedly engages in padding-then-refund behavior, with an abnormally high ratio of retained discounts or rebates
Order splits cluster at the moment a promotion triggers, and refunds concentrate on the padding items
